reading.title: Back to Hong Kong
reading.intro: 黃家正從加拿大搬回香港。馬克叔叔來幫卡羅爾和比爾拆箱。閱讀故事，找出每件物品屬於誰：

paragraphs.text:
The Wong family are moving back from Canada to Hong Kong. Mr and Mrs Wong are busy buying new furniture. Uncle Mark comes to their new flat and helps Carol and Bill unpack the boxes.
'Welcome back to Hong Kong,' says Uncle Mark. 'We're thrilled that we're back in Hong Kong. It's such an exciting city!' says Carol.
paragraphs.translation:
黃家正從加拿大搬回香港。黃先生和黃太太忙著買新家具。馬克叔叔來到他們的新公寓，幫卡羅爾和比爾拆箱。
「歡迎回到香港，」馬克叔叔說。「我們很高興回到香港。這是一個令人興奮的城市！」卡羅爾說。

paragraphs.translation: 比爾、卡羅爾和馬克叔叔正在拆箱。馬克叔叔拿著一個卡通企鵝形狀的鬧鐘。「我在你的房間裡找到這個，比爾。我覺得它不是你的。是卡羅爾的嗎？」「是的，是她的，」比爾說。「可以請你把它放到她的房間嗎？」

listening.title: 聆聽練習：最後一個箱子
listening.description: 還有一個箱子要拆。聆聽 Bill 和 Carol 的對話，完成表格，寫出每件物品屬於誰：

script.title: Unpacking the last box（拆最後一個箱子）
script.text: There is one box left to unpack. Let's open it, Bill! OK! I wonder what's inside. Look! There are some earrings and a necklace. Whose are they? They're Carol's. They're hers. Great. And here's a wallet. Is it Dad's? Yes, it's his. Put it with Dad's things, please. What about this blanket and this pillow? Are they Mum's? The blanket is hers, but the pillow is for guests. And this suitcase? Whose is it? It's Carol's. And this desk lamp is yours, Bill! Hooray! Now everything is unpacked.
script.zh:
還剩一個箱子要拆。我們打開它吧，比爾！
好的！我好奇裡面有什麼。
看！有一些耳環和一條項鏈。它們是誰的？
它們是卡羅爾的。是她的。
太好了。這裡還有一個錢包。是爸爸的嗎？
是的，是他的。請把它放到爸爸的東西那裡。
那這條毯子和這個枕頭呢？是媽媽的嗎？
毯子是她的，但枕頭是給客人用的。
那這個手提箱呢？是誰的？
是卡羅爾的。而這盞檯燈是你的，比爾！
好耶！現在所有東西都拆好了。

practice.intro: 根據 Unit 1（Back to Hong Kong）內容完成以下練習題：

readingComp.title: 練習 1：閱讀理解選擇題
readingComp.description: 根據課文內容，選擇最佳答案：

questions.text: 1. Where does the Wong family move back from?
questions.explanation: 課文說 The Wong family are moving back from Canada to Hong Kong，所以選 b。

questions.text: 2. What does Carol's alarm clock look like?
questions.explanation: 課文說 an alarm clock in the shape of a cartoon penguin，所以選 c。

questions.text: 3. Whose desk lamp is it?
questions.explanation: 比爾說 That's mine，檯燈是比爾的，所以選 d。

questions.text: 4. Why does Uncle Mark go to the bedroom?

options.text: c. to look at the album

questions.explanation: 課文說 I need them for a nap，馬克叔叔去臥室睡午覺，所以選 a。

questions.text: 5. Whose mattress is it?
questions.explanation: 卡羅爾說 I think it's Mum and Dad's，所以選 b。

readingQA.title: 練習 2：閱讀理解問答題
readingQA.description: 根據課文內容，用完整的句子回答下列問題：

questions.q: 1. Who does the photo album belong to?
questions.a: It belongs to Bill and Carol. It's ours.
questions.explanation: 課文說 It's ours，相冊屬於孩子們。

questions.a: He is annoyed because the children are looking at a photo album and not putting things away.
questions.zh: 馬克叔叔為什麼很煩躁？
questions.explanation: 課文說 He wonders why the children are looking at a photo album and not putting things away。

questions.q: 3. What will Bill and Carol do after Uncle Mark goes to the bedroom?
questions.a: They will unpack the boxes. They still have lots of boxes to unpack.
questions.zh: 馬克叔叔去臥室後，比爾和卡羅爾會做什麼？
questions.explanation: 課文最後說 Let's unpack this box. We still have lots of boxes to unpack。

wordBank.title: 練習 3：Words to learn 看圖選詞填空
wordBank.description: 閱讀提示，從詞庫中選出正確的物品名稱：

items.prompt: It wakes me up in the morning.（早上叫醒我）
We cover ourselves with it in bed.（睡覺時蓋在身上）
It gives us light on the desk.（在書桌上給我們光）
People wear them on their ears.（戴在耳朵上）
We wear them on our hands in cold weather.（天冷時戴在手上）
We sleep on it in bed.（睡覺時躺在上面）
People wear it around their neck.（戴在脖子上）
We put our head on it in bed.（睡覺時頭枕在上面）
We put our clothes in it for a trip.（旅行時放衣服）
We keep money and cards in it.（放錢和卡）

discussion.title: 練習 4：Speaking 角色扮演（Whose ... is this?）
discussion.description: 和同學輪流扮演 Uncle Mark 和 Carol，用 Whose ... is this? 找出地板上的物品屬於誰：
questions: Whose pillow is this? Is it your mum's?（這是誰的枕頭？是你媽媽的嗎？）
No, it isn't hers. It's mine.（不，不是她的。是我的。）
Whose photo album is this? Is it Bill's?（這是誰的相冊？是比爾的嗎？）
Whose gloves are these? Are they Carol's?（這些是誰的手套？是卡羅爾的嗎？）

questions.text: 1. Which one wakes us up in the morning?
questions.explanation: 鬧鐘（alarm clock）早上叫我們起床。

questions.text: 2. We keep money and cards in a ______.
questions.explanation: 錢包（wallet）放錢和卡。

questions.text: 3. Which one do we wear on our hands?
questions.explanation: 手套（gloves）戴在手上。

questions.text: 4. We put our clothes in a ______ for a trip.
questions.explanation: 旅行時把手提箱（suitcase）裝衣服。

questions.text: 5. Which one do we put our head on in bed?
questions.explanation: 枕頭（pillow）墊頭。

sections.title: 文法題：物主代詞（每題 1 分）

questions.text: 1. Whose desk lamp is this? — It's ______. It's Bill's.
questions.explanation: 比爾說 That's mine，所以用 mine（我的）。

questions.text: 2. Whose alarm clock is this? — It's Carol's. Yes, it's ______.
questions.explanation: 鬧鐘是卡羅爾（她）的，用 hers（她的）。

questions.text: 3. Whose photo album is that? — It's ______. The children say 'It's ours.'
questions.explanation: 孩子們說 It's ours，所以是 ours（我們的）。

questions.text: 4. Whose mattress is this? — It's Mum and Dad's. Yes, it's ______.
questions.explanation: 床墊是爸爸媽媽（他們）的，用 theirs（他們的）。

questions.text: 5. Are these your dad's? — No, they aren't ______.
questions.explanation: 比爾說 No, they aren't his，所以用 his（他的）。

questions.text: 1. Where are the Wongs moving back to?
questions.explanation: 課文說 moving back from Canada to Hong Kong，所以是搬回香港。

questions.text: 2. Who helps Carol and Bill unpack the boxes?
questions.explanation: 課文說 Uncle Mark comes to their new flat and helps Carol and Bill unpack the boxes。

questions.text: 3. What does 'grumpy' mean?
questions.explanation: Uncle Mark 因孩子們不拆箱而生氣，grumpily 是氣沖沖地（不高興、煩躁）。

questions.text: 4. Who are the blanket and pillow for?
questions.explanation: 比爾說 They're for guests，毯子和枕頭是給客人用的。

questions.text: 5. How does Uncle Mark feel at the end of the story?
questions.explanation: 馬克叔叔說 I'm exhausted（我太累了），之後去睡午覺。
